verdict.rationale: Devin is itself a coding agent, but its first-party docs describe a Devin MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible agent or IDE access to session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling. They also cover cron and one-time scheduling and repository documentation queries, so the server axis applies and the core story is delivered. Client-side MCP docs, where the Devin CLI connects to external servers, are not credited here. Missing for 10: connection and setup details (endpoint, transport, authentication flow), deprecation or stability status, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.
